replies.title: Quick replies
replies.sub: Saved answers for the questions customers ask every day. Type / and the short name in any chat.
replies.top: Most used: /{name} ({n} times). Keep prices and delivery words here up to date when your rules change.
replies.never: Quick replies are never deleted. Archived ones stop showing in chats and can come back any time.
replies.confirmArchive: Archive this quick reply? It stops showing in chats. You can restore it from Archived.
replies.fShortHint: Typed as /name in the chat box. Letters and digits only.
replies.off: Quick replies are switched off. Switch them on to start with 8 saved answers you can edit.

comments.title: Comments
comments.sub: {need} comments need a reply · {hidden} hidden · {auto} got a message by themselves
comments.question: Asks price or size
comments.sentPractice: Practice only: the Page is not connected yet, nothing was sent
comments.off: The comment desk is switched off. Switch it on in the rules below.
comments.rPhone: Hide comments with a phone number (others cannot copy it)
comments.rAuto: A comment that asks price or size gets a private message and a public reply by itself
comments.rKeywords: Words that start the private message
comments.note: Hiding keeps the words in the inbox; nothing is deleted. Until the Page's keys are typed in, hiding and replying are practice only.

live.title: Live selling
live.sub: Comments like "P1 L 2 pcs" become pieces in the person's chat bag. Staff always confirm by a call.
live.off: Live selling is switched off. Switch it on under More options.
live.fCodes: Product codes said on the live
live.endConfirm: End this live session? Its comments stay.
live.r_UNKNOWN_CODE: This code was not said on the live
live.guessed: no code, so the first code
live.colour: Confirm the colour on the call
live.handHint: Practice, until the Page's keys are in: type what a viewer would write.
live.res_CART_OFF: Orders from the chat are off
live.note: A draft is the piece in the person's chat bag. Call to confirm colour and address, then press Create order in the chat.

aff.title: Influencers & affiliates
aff.sub: Each partner gets a personal code. They earn commission only on delivered orders — returned parcels earn nothing.
aff.off: Influencers and affiliates are switched off. Switch them on under More options.
aff.holdNote: Commission is payable {days} days after delivery.
aff.payOff: Paying partners is not switched on. The owner decides when.
aff.payConfirm: Pay {name} {amount}? It is added to the ledger and to the costs.
aff.note: The code is the code of a coupon you made: the coupon gives the buyer the discount, this page only counts the partner's commission.
